lead: A `decimal` class constant declares cleanly and fails at the *read*, with `E0792: has no compile-time value to inline`.
body: A constant is inlined at every use site, and `crates/nvs-types/src/defaults.rs`'s module doc says the `ConstArg` variant carrying `InstKind::ConstDecimal` is unbuilt, so the grid folds the literal to nothing — the declaration itself says nothing about it. Keep the rate as an `int` percentage and divide, or write the literal at the use site.
